contents/config/main.xml.anchor:
<entry name="wheelSkipMinimized" type="Bool">
      <label>Whether to skip minimized tasks when switching between them using the mouse wheel.</label>
      <default>true</default>
    </entry>
contents/config/main.xml.text:
<entry name="appVolumeEnabled" type="Bool">
      <label>Whether scrolling over a task with audio streams adjusts its volume.</label>
      <default>true</default>
    </entry>
    <entry name="appVolumeModifier" type="Enum">
      <label>Modifier key required for per-app wheel volume control.</label>
      <choices>
        <choice name="None"/>
        <choice name="Alt"/>
      </choices>
      <default>0</default>
    </entry>

contents/ui/ConfigBehavior.qml.text:
property alias cfg_appVolumeEnabled: appVolumeEnabled.checked
    property alias cfg_appVolumeModifier: appVolumeModifier.currentIndex

contents/ui/ConfigBehavior.qml.anchor:
QQC2.CheckBox {
            id: wheelSkipMinimized
            leftPadding: mirrored ? 0 : (wheelEnabled.indicator.width + wheelEnabled.spacing)
            rightPadding: mirrored ? (wheelEnabled.indicator.width + wheelEnabled.spacing) : 0
            text: i18nc("@option:check mouse wheel task cycling", "Skip minimized tasks")
            enabled: wheelEnabled.currentIndex !== 0 // None
        }
